title: A comparison of the weakest contractive conditions for Banach and Kannan mappings
summary: We study the weakest convergence-type conditions for fixed point results for Banach and Kannan mappings. Building on Suzuki's weakest condition for Banach mappings and our previous result for Kannan mappings, we compare convergence conditions defined along Picard sequences. We give a direct proof that several weakest convergence conditions are equivalent for Kannan-type mappings on complete metric spaces.
